original_r4_a_acceptance.seed_direction_rule: at least two of three oracle seeds have positive macro gain and no seed has a 95% CI entirely at or below -3%
original_r4_a_acceptance.aggregation: per-episode median error over three frozen seeds, followed by 10000 task-stratified paired episode bootstrap resamples
original_r4_a_acceptance.control_rule: oracle ARB must have a positive 95% CI lower bound versus zero residual, input-independent noise residual and legacy concat
original_r4_a_acceptance.failure_rule: if any oracle check fails, stop R4 without training an ARB predictor or opening a test split

immutability.rule: The original gate file in the original implementation/run remains the decision source for the already-started run. Its contents, hashes and resulting decision may not be overwritten by protocol amendment A01.
immutability.full_snapshot_location: Preserved with the original implementation and run artifacts; this tracked manifest records the content-addressed identity and the original blocking acceptance rule because docs/experiments is intentionally ignored in the active worktree.
